newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-BRUGUERA TO FACE KUERTEN IN FRENCH FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BRUGUERA TO FACE KUERTEN IN FRENCH FINAL.

text.p: Spain's Sergi Bruguera will face unseeded Brazilian Gustavo Kuerten in Sunday's French Open men's final after ending Australian Pat Rafter's brave semifinal challenge on Friday.
Bruguera, twice a former champion at Roland Garros in 1993 and 1994, beat Rafter 6-7 6-1 7-5 7-6 to prevent what would have been the first French men's final in history without a seeded participant.
The Spanish 16th seed now meets the 66th-ranked Kuerten, a 6-1 3-6 6-1 7-6 winner over Belgian qualifier Filip Dewulf.
Kuerten, aged 20, will be bidding to become the first unseeded winner in Paris since Mats Wilander in 1982.
